title: How Well Does He Know Me
trend: Couple quiz skits ('how well does my boyfriend/husband know me'; #bf couple skits Rising, SocialPilot TikTok hashtag table Nov 17-25 2026, US) — quiz/game-show format: Renee quizzes husband Darnell with ten cards and a gleeful buzzer; he scores zero for four (chili not spaghetti, the cooking show not the boat movie, a cabin not Paris, green not pink); twist: the cards are from her two thousand nine dating profile — he knows the woman she became (chili since their second date, the mint bathroom, crying at the cabin brochure), so he got them all right; button: he writes the new cards, they both snore, and chili is a question and an order
youtube_title: I quizzed my husband on me. He got zero. Then he read the cards 💍
description:
Renee has ten questions and a very excited buzzer. Darnell has been married to her for fifteen years and gets every answer wrong. Then he asks where the answers came from.

#cartoon #animation #funny #marriage #shorts
tiktok_caption: how well does my husband know me? ten questions 💍 #cartoon #animation #funny #marriage

lines.text: How well does my husband know me? Ten questions. Let us find out.
Fifteen years married. I could do this asleep. I have done this asleep.
I am the buzzer. I have been waiting all day to be loud.
Question one. What is my favorite food?
Easy. My chili.
The card says spaghetti.
Wrong. Very wrong. Wrong like socks with sandals.
Who wrote that card?
Me. Question two. What is my favorite movie?
That cooking show where the old man cries over bread.
Card says the one with the boat and the ice.
Wrong again. I love my job.
You fall asleep in that movie. Every time. Before the ice.
Question three. What is my dream vacation?
A cabin. No phone. Me making chili.
Paris.
You got lost in a mall once and called me crying from the pretzel place.
Wrong. But I believe him about the pretzel place.
Zero for three, Darnell. Zero.
Zero. In my own kitchen. In front of a buzzer.
Question four. Favorite color?
Green. Your whole closet is green.
Card says pink.
Wrong. I am starting to feel bad. No. I am not.
Renee. Where did you get these answers?
From my old dating profile. Two thousand nine. To be accurate.
Two thousand nine?
That is the real me. In writing. Signed.
Baby, that is the you from before. I married the you from after.
Spaghetti? You have not had spaghetti since I made chili on our second date.
That is true. I said it was the best thing I ever ate.
You still say it. Every Sunday. With your mouth full.
Pink? You painted the bathroom green and told the neighbors it was mint.
It is mint.
Paris? You wanted to go to a cabin last year. You cried at the brochure.
Hold on. Am I wrong? Have I been wrong this whole time?
So you got them all right.
I got them all right. The card got them all wrong.
The card is fifteen years old.
So am I, in husband years.
Correct. All of it. Correct, correct, correct.
Okay. New rule. You write the answers now.
Question five. Who is your favorite person?
You.
Correct. Finally, a happy buzz.
Question six. Who snores?
You.
Wrong. It is you.
I have been in the bedroom. It is both of you.
Question seven. What is my favorite thing about you?
My chili.
Your laugh. When you burn the chili.
I never burn the chili.
Wrong. Tuesday. The smoke alarm and I are friends now.
Final question. Will you make chili tonight?
Is that a question or an order?
Both.
Then yes. Correct answer.
Perfect score. I have never been so proud of a marriage.
